# YourAdChoices.com
> Consumer-facing site from the Digital Advertising Alliance explaining interest-based advertising and how to control ad choices.

YourAdChoices.com helps people understand the AdChoices icon, relevant advertising, industry principles, and available consumer opt-out tools.

## Learn
- [Learn](https://aboutads.info/learn): Overview of interest-based advertising, the AdChoices icon, and how consumer choice tools work.
- [What's Behind the AdChoices Icon](https://aboutads.info/learn): Explains what the AdChoices icon means and how it connects to ad transparency.
- [The Benefits of Relevant Advertising](https://aboutads.info/learn): Describes how relevant advertising supports free content and more useful ad experiences.

## Control
- [Control](https://aboutads.info/control): Central consumer choice page for managing advertising preferences and opt-out options.
- [Take Control with YourAdChoices](https://aboutads.info/control): Explains how to use available tools to exercise advertising choice.
- [Put the AdChoices Icon to Work for You](https://aboutads.info/control): Shows how the icon can be used to learn about and manage ad settings.

## Principles
- [Principles](https://aboutads.info/principles): Summarizes the DAA self-regulatory principles governing interest-based advertising practices.
- [Interest-Based Advertising Principles](https://aboutads.info/principles): Describes the standards companies follow for notice, choice, and accountability.
- [Consumer Transparency and Choice](https://aboutads.info/principles): Covers the program’s emphasis on clear notice and user control.

## About the DAA
- [About the DAA](https://aboutads.info/about): Introduces the Digital Advertising Alliance and its role in self-regulation.
- [DAA Program Overview](https://aboutads.info/about): Explains the organization behind the AdChoices program and consumer tools.
- [For Businesses](https://digitaladvertisingalliance.org): Business-facing Digital Advertising Alliance site with program and industry information.

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://aboutads.info/privacy-policy): Describes how the site handles information and privacy-related practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://aboutads.info/terms-of-use): Sets the legal terms governing use of the website and its materials.

## Main Navigation
- [Home](https://aboutads.info/): Homepage introducing YourAdChoices and its consumer education resources.
- [Learn](https://aboutads.info/learn): Educational content about relevant advertising and the AdChoices icon.
- [Control](https://aboutads.info/control): Consumer tools and guidance for managing ad preferences.
- [Principles](https://aboutads.info/principles): DAA principles and self-regulatory framework.
- [About the DAA](https://aboutads.info/about): Background on the organization operating the program.
